title: Doesn't fit spaghetti noodles
text: Doesn't fit spaghetti noodles. The photo clearly shows spaghetti noodles and we had two different brand of spaghetti we tried and each was at least 1/2" too long and wouldn't fit into the container. Not thrilled given that was the purpose of picking up this item but it does have a nice look to it and the lid seals ok (not sure on airtight though).
